title: List the names of female superheroes published by Dark Horse Comics who are
question: List the names of female superheroes published by Dark Horse Comics who are among the top 10 superheroes with the most powers.

prediction.sql:
SELECT s."XCL_019" AS hero_name
FROM superhero AS s
INNER JOIN gender AS g ON s."XCL_021" = g."XCL_007"
INNER JOIN publisher AS p ON s."XCL_026" = p."XCL_014"
WHERE g."XCL_008" = 'Female'
  AND p."XCL_015" = 'Dark Horse Comics'
  AND s."XCL_018" IN (
    SELECT hp2."XCL_012"
    FROM hero_power AS hp2
    GROUP BY hp2."XCL_012"
    ORDER BY COUNT(hp2."XCL_013") DESC
    LIMIT 10
  )
